import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

# ---------- sequences + alignment (same method as iteration 1) ----------
ACCS={"GLH2":"Q966L9","GLH1":"P34689","VASA":"P09052","DDX4":"Q9NQI0"}
S={k:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=30).text.strip().split("\n")[1:]) for k,a in ACCS.items()}
b62="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
rows=b62.strip().split("\n");hdr=rows[0].split();AA={a:i for i,a in enumerate(hdr)}
M62=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()[1:]] for r in rows[1:]],float)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11.,ge=-1.):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-1e9
    Sm=M62[np.ix_([AA.get(c,0) for c in s1],[AA.get(c,0) for c in s2])]
    Mx=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);Mx[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1);pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1);pY[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Mp,Xp,Yp=Mx[i-1],Ix[i-1],Iy[i-1];row=Sm[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=row[j-1]
            c=(Mp[j-1]+s,Xp[j-1]+s,Yp[j-1]+s);k=0 if c[0]>=c[1] and c[0]>=c[2] else (1 if c[1]>=c[2] else 2);Mx[i,j]=c[k];pM[i,j]=k
            cx=(Mp[j]+go,Xp[j]+ge,Yp[j]+go);k=0 if cx[0]>=cx[1] and cx[0]>=cx[2] else (1 if cx[1]>=cx[2] else 2);Ix[i,j]=cx[k];pX[i,j]=k
            cy=(Mx[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k=0 if cy[0]>=cy[1] and cy[0]>=cy[2] else (1 if cy[1]>=cy[2] else 2);Iy[i,j]=cy[k];pY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax((Mx[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m])));A=[];B=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: A.append('-');B.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1;continue
        if j==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);B.append('-');i-=1;continue
        if st==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);B.append(s2[j-1]);st=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: A.append(s1[i-1]);B.append('-');st=pX[i,j];i-=1
        else: A.append('-');B.append(s2[j-1]);st=pY[i,j];j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(B))
VST,VEN=202,621; vsub=S["VASA"][VST-1:VEN]
REG={"GLH2":(520,974),"GLH1":(310,763),"DDX4":(255,724)}
maps={}
for k,(st,en) in REG.items():
    a,b=nw(S[k][st-1:en],vsub); qi=st-1;vi=VST-1;mp={}
    for ca,cb in zip(a,b):
        if ca!='-': qi+=1
        if cb!='-': vi+=1
        if ca!='-' and cb!='-': mp[vi]=(qi,ca)
    maps[k]=mp

# ---------- 2DB3 interdomain (RecA1 <-> RecA2) interface in the closed, ATP+RNA-bound state ----------
pdb=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/2DB3.pdb",timeout=60).text
t2o=dict(ALA='A',ARG='R',ASN='N',ASP='D',CYS='C',GLN='Q',GLU='E',GLY='G',HIS='H',ILE='I',LEU='L',
         LYS='K',MET='M',PHE='F',PRO='P',SER='S',THR='T',TRP='W',TYR='Y',VAL='V',MSE='M')
at=[];seq={}
for L in pdb.split("\n"):
    if L.startswith(("ATOM  ","HETATM")) and L[21]=='A' and L[17:20].strip() in t2o and L[16] in (' ','A'):
        n=int(L[22:26]); at.append((n,np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])))
        seq[n]=t2o[L[17:20].strip()]
REC1=(202,436); REC2=(437,621)
A1=[(n,x) for n,x in at if REC1[0]<=n<=REC1[1]]
A2=[(n,x) for n,x in at if REC2[0]<=n<=REC2[1]]
X1=np.array([x for _,x in A1]); X2=np.array([x for _,x in A2])
D=np.sqrt(((X1[:,None,:]-X2[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1))
ii,jj=np.where(D<4.0)
iface=sorted({A1[i][0] for i in ii}|{A2[j][0] for j in jj})
print("RecA1-RecA2 interdomain interface residues in closed Vasa (<4.0 A, n=%d):"%len(iface))
print([f"{seq[p]}{p}" for p in iface])
rows=[]
for p in iface:
    v=seq[p]; d={"Vasa":f"{v}{p}","domain":"RecA1" if p<=REC1[1] else "RecA2"}
    for k in REG:
        d[k]=f"{maps[k][p][1]}{maps[k][p][0]}" if p in maps[k] else "gap"
        d[k+"_same"]= (p in maps[k] and maps[k][p][1]==v)
    rows.append(d)
ifd=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(ifd.to_string(index=False))
for k in REG:
    print(f"{k}: interdomain-interface identity to Vasa = {ifd[k+'_same'].sum()}/{len(ifd)} ({100*ifd[k+'_same'].mean():.0f}%)")
ifd.to_csv("glh2_vasa_interdomain_interface.csv",index=False)

# ---------- figure ----------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,3.4))
for i,(k,lab,yy) in enumerate(zip(["DDX4","GLH1","GLH2"],["DDX4","GLH-1","GLH-2"],[2,1,0])):
    for j in range(len(ifd)):
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((j-0.45,yy-0.4),0.9,0.8,
            fc="#2a6f4e" if ifd[k+"_same"][j] else "#c0504d",ec="white",lw=0.6))
    ax.text(-1.3,yy,lab,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=10)
for j in range(len(ifd)):
    ax.text(j,2.7,ifd.Vasa[j],rotation=90,ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=6.5,
            color="#1f4e79" if ifd.domain[j]=="RecA1" else "#7a4b00")
ax.text(0,-1.1,"blue = RecA1 (202-436), brown = RecA2 (437-621); interface defined as any heavy-atom pair <4.0 A across domains in 2DB3 chain A",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(-7,len(ifd)-0.3); ax.set_ylim(-1.35,3.8); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("Conservation of the Vasa RecA1-RecA2 interdomain interface, the contacts Sengoku et al. showed couple ATP hydrolysis to unwinding",fontsize=10.5,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nfiles in cwd:",sorted(os.listdir(".")))
